pages.text: Industrial Foregoing's Dissolution Chamber is this pack's slime engine. From the Tide tier on it is the only way to make Resource Slimes - the early hand-craft chains stop, and the chamber takes over for every tier after.

Each recipe dissolves a pile of items in latex and presses out a Slime in a Bucket. The shape is always the same: 100 mB latex (melt a Plastic Froglight in the Crucible), the prior resource, four tier-filler blocks, and three Sweetslime. Check JEI for the exact resource each variant takes.
